# Anointed Automation

> Open-source .NET / NuGet libraries by Anointed Automation, LLC, stewarded by Alexander Fields. This repository (github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation) is a collection of small, focused, dependency-light C# packages published to NuGet under the AnointedAutomation.* prefix.

Primary site: https://anointedautomation.net
NuGet profile: https://www.nuget.org/profiles/roku674

## Packages

- [AnointedAutomation.Algorithms](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Algorithms): Algorithms for .NET with no dependencies, starting with a pure C# QR code encoder (ISO/IEC 18004) with Reed-Solomon error correction and automatic version and mask selection.
- [AnointedAutomation.APIMiddlewares](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.APIMiddlewares): ASP.NET Core middleware and filters for API key authentication, IP blacklisting, invalid endpoint tracking and idle time memory cleanup.
- [AnointedAutomation.Concepts](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Concepts): Models Biblical concepts as .NET types: love as a behavior tree, a moral reality that reads acts against God's character, and an epistemics engine that checks claims for consistency.
- [AnointedAutomation.Enums](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Enums): Shared enumerations for AnointedAutomation packages: payment types, providers, transaction and subscription statuses, payment operations, card types, webhook events, and moderation categories.
- [AnointedAutomation.Imaging](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Imaging): Renders QR codes from AnointedAutomation.Algorithms to SVG and PNG using only the .NET base class library, with no third party image dependency.
- [AnointedAutomation.Logging](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Logging): A lightweight log message model with severity levels, automatic caller detection and a static LogAdded event for routing logs.
- [AnointedAutomation.Mathematics](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Mathematics): A curated catalog of laws, theories, and conjectures from logic, mathematics, physics, and chemistry, modeled as foundational claims for the AnointedAutomation.Concepts epistemics engine.
- [AnointedAutomation.Memory](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Memory): On demand garbage collection helper that forces a full collection and tries to return unused memory to the operating system.
- [AnointedAutomation.Objects](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Objects): Plain POCO models for user accounts, billing and payments, single sign-on identities (Google, Microsoft, Apple, Facebook, Shopify), and standard API response envelopes.
- [AnointedAutomation.Objects.API](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Objects.API): ASP.NET Core helpers: an in memory IFormFile, a hybrid casing System.Text.Json naming convention, and a GraphQL response envelope reader.
- [AnointedAutomation.Optimization](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Optimization): Reusable optimization utilities: CSV/DataTable/DataReader helpers, chunking, string helpers, Roman numerals, JSON flattening, file management, and null-safe JsonElement/BsonDocument field accessors.
- [AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo): A MongoDB helper and generic repository base for .NET, with CRUD, paging, aggregation, index management, BSON class maps and casing conventions.
- [AnointedAutomation.Repository.MySql](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Repository.MySql): A generic repository and helper for MySQL over Entity Framework Core and the Pomelo provider.
- [AnointedAutomation.Shopify](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Shopify): Plain Newtonsoft.Json POCO models for the Shopify Admin REST API (customers, orders, products, fulfillments, inventory, refunds, transactions, webhooks and more), derived from ShopifySharp's REST entities. Models only: no HTTP client, no services, no GraphQL types.
